annotations.name: TOD_purchase_mod_native
annotations.comment: Hero inventory transaction: obtains cost from 0x2D1E80, checks raritanium +0x420 and record ownership +0x10, enables the selected bit through 0x465D00, and deducts cost via 0x24F748. No grid adjacency/already-owned-bit check in this leaf; script UI performs separate checks.
annotations.evidence: Wrapper 0x26400 -> thunk 0x12A20 -> 0x2D2878; raw calls 0x2D2934 and 0x2D2948.

annotations.name: TOD_get_mod_cost_native
annotations.comment: Returns zero for missing definition/config or node index outside NumMods. Reads word config +0x470 + node*0x18, equivalently modifier entry +0x0C. An out-of-range node producing zero price is not proven safe to purchase.
annotations.evidence: Definition config +0x48 and NumMods +0x6A4; called by purchase transaction 0x2D2878.

annotations.name: TOD_Lua_config_Mods_getter
annotations.comment: Named Mods[index] getter. Unsigned index checked against 0x17 (24 slots), entry pointer config +0x464 + index*0x18. Physical capacity does not establish 24 purchasable nodes for every weapon.
annotations.evidence: Native name/getter descriptor slot 0x88E8A0; index check 0xB7BD8 and address calculation 0xB7C04.

annotations.name: TOD_Lua_config_Mods_setter
annotations.comment: Named Mods[index] setter, 24-slot check, copies six four-byte words into config +0x464 + index*0x18. Mod entry size 0x18; runtime configuration, not saved modifier mask.
annotations.evidence: Native name/setter descriptor slot 0x88E8A0 and raw six-word stores.

annotations.name: TOD_purchase_weapon_native
annotations.comment: Native branch of named purchase_weapon: requires hero, checks a special condition for ID 0x13, obtains price from 0x2D2058, compares bolts at hero inventory +0x41C, acquires/refills via 0x466B70, integrates hero inventory through 0x252B08, and deducts price via 0x24FCB8. Additional virtual dispatch and notifications follow. This leaf alone does not establish all vendor availability/prerequisite checks.
annotations.evidence: Named Lua chain 0x337D8 -> 0x26638 -> thunk 0x12010; raw instructions at 0x2D2DA0, 0x2D2DE8 and 0x2D2E10.

annotations.name: TOD_get_weapon_purchase_price_native
annotations.comment: Looks up definition, returns zero for missing definition/config; selects weapon config +0x6AC (AmmoPrice) when definition flag 2 is set, otherwise +0x6A8 (BasePrice). Vendor native bindings independently name these fields.
annotations.evidence: 0x2D2098/0x2D20B8 plus Vendor getter 0x99B20 and price getters 0xB4BB0/0xB4AE0.

annotations.name: TOD_register_Lua_config_and_constants
annotations.comment: Large native Lua registration routine. Named config property getter/setter descriptors connect MaxAmmo, NumMods, Vendor, and named weapon subobjects to concrete field accessors. Also exports numeric MOD_AMMO=9. Not a function that loads or executes the CSV itself.
annotations.evidence: TOC 0x88FF38; string/descriptor slots 0x88E84C, 0x88E8AC, 0x88E8B8, 0x88ED38, 0x88ED5C; registration calls 0x893C8, 0x89488, 0x894A0 and 0x80E48.

annotations.name: TOD_Lua_config_MaxAmmo_getter
annotations.comment: Named MaxAmmo property getter. Float array at weapon config +0x280, stride 4, index range 0..19. Native capacity is 20; shipped CSV fills only ten levels for the 15 upgradeable weapons.
annotations.evidence: Name slot 0x88E84C -> getter descriptor 0x85E990; raw lfsx and index check corroborate native ammo calculation 0x466500.

annotations.name: TOD_Lua_config_MaxAmmo_setter
annotations.comment: Named MaxAmmo property setter. Checks unsigned index against 0x13 and stores f32 at config +0x280 + 4*index. This changes runtime config, not directly the save-record ammo field.
annotations.evidence: Name slot 0x88E84C -> setter descriptor 0x85E988; instructions 0xB87D0, 0xB87FC and stfsx 0xB880C.

annotations.name: TOD_Lua_config_NumMods_getter

annotations.name: TOD_Lua_config_NumMods_setter
